name: hero-pattern-hole
title: Hero pattern hole
description: Attributes for excluding content areas from dot-pattern backgrounds.
usage: Marking a hero's or a card's content so HeroDotField and HeroCirclePatternSurface keep their dots off it: spread `patternHole("text")` on a heading.
